name: Aquatic Form
summary: In Thunder Bluff, a young Horde druid returns to master the waters. After proving worthy in Moonglade and attuning to the sea lion aspect, the druid comes home for formal recognition and Aquatic Form.

sections.title: Return of the Sea Lion
sections.body: Dendrite Starblaze sends the aspiring tauren druid back to Mulgore after the trials in Moonglade. The Pendant of the Sea Lion bears proof of balance and dedication through Kalimdor's waters. Carrying it shows the initiate has honored the ancient traditions needed to take an aquatic aspect.

sections.title: Communion with the Waters
sections.body: At Thunder Bluff's heights, the traveler presents the pendant to Turak Runetotem, their mentor. Pleased that the initiate has honored their ancestors and kept the balance of nature, Turak teaches the secret of the aquatic form. The druid can then move beneath rivers and oceans, breathe freely, and navigate the depths as a sea creature.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: This rite brings a young Horde druid's passage to its end. In Thunder Bluff, the druid presents the Pendant of the Sea Lion and learns Aquatic Form.

faq.q: Who do I bring the Pendant of the Sea Lion to?
aliases: where to turn in aquatic form
faq.answer: Bring the Pendant of the Sea Lion to Turak Runetotem, the druid trainer on Thunder Bluff's upper rises in Mulgore.

faq.q: Who sends you back to Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze sends you back after your aquatic trials in Moonglade are complete.

aliases: can other classes do aquatic form
faq.answer: No. Only druids can complete this rite, which advances their spiritual and magical path toward animal forms.

faq.q: Why does a night elf in Moonglade help a Horde druid?
faq.answer: Moonglade is a neutral sanctuary overseen by the Cenarion Circle. Night elf mentors guide tauren druids in the ancient Cenarion arts, seeking nature's balance without political hostility.

faq.q: What ability does completing this quest grant?
faq.answer: Turak Runetotem teaches you Aquatic Form. While shapeshifted, you swim faster and breathe underwater.

angles.text: As a druid, Aquatic Form lets you cross bodies of water with ease and escape predators in the deep.
As a tauren, mastering the beasts of the sea honors your ancestors and strengthens your people's return to druidic ways.
As a member of the Horde, you share the tauren druids' spiritual link to the Cenarion Circle, walking between neutral sanctuaries and tribal capitals.
